reviews.title: Video card for computer
reviews.comment: I don't know much about this. I bought it, my son put it in my computer and it was an upgrade. It works. Computer is running better. I've got GeForce components in computer. My old video card from them was about 10+ years and still worked. It was outdated so needed upgrade.
reviews.author: Liz

reviews.title: Great for Folding @ Home
reviews.comment: I've only used this to crunch F@H numbers.  Has  a 192 bit bus.  Does quite well compared to the 1650 model (the 1650  only has a 128 bit bus).  Have not tested it for games.  Download the drivers and run MSI Afterburn to tweak the graphic card numbers
reviews.author: Sulaco Survivor

reviews.title: Great Value and just the right performance.
reviews.comment: It fit into my system where others did not.  It is frugal on power and only starts the fans when needed.
reviews.author: Graham who knows more than you do
